architecture_constraints: selected and unselected bottom plates must never connect VDD and ground simultaneously
source acquisition must be disconnected before redistribution
comparator input switches must be off during DAC redistribution
endpoint initialization must not rely on a floating node initial condition
the threshold map must be measured from the same topology used in the SAR
